snippet.title: Blueprint Hell - GMTK Game Jam 2024 Winner
snippet.description:
"Blueprint Hell" takes the challenge of managing your code as your project scales and turns it into a puzzle-based game that is inspired by visual programming languages.

It was made in 96 hours for GMTK Game Jam 2024, themed "Built to Scale"
Play at : https://egunan.itch.io/blueprint-hell
